statement: Native GMP replay accepts archived P-192 d7 finite-field, genus2 torsion and tangent witnesses after the recorded monic coordinate normalization: four independent order3 divisors,81 classes, actual Frobenius action, four cubic tangent identities and six Weil pairings. The elliptic basis/order/Frobenius/pairing also replay. This is a producer implementation, not signed independent verification, and does not construct a quotient.
